context_title:
I want to build an app like Perplexity, but without exposing the underlying models. Instead, multiple models should collaborate every time, and the system should always present itself under a single name: Jade.

I want it to be much more intelligent: not just searching and reading 10–30 sources, then answering like Perplexity, but even thousands if needed. Truly intelligent: not just looking at the sources that every other AI app does, but when I search for something, it should research, decide, figure out what to search for and where, across multiple steps, in which order; infer, evaluate, think, doubt, and be curious, etc. It should be able to research autonomously for hours if necessary.

What I have: Cerebras models (I’d obviously use the most advanced), GPT, OSS 120B Qwen 3, Grok 4 and Grok 4 Fast API, Exa AI API.

I want a fully Apple‑grade, iOS‑feeling, launch PWA that looks like the Apple MacBook Pro and iPhone Air websites. I want the backend to be a single main.py and the frontend to be a single index.html.

Deliver the entire codebase for Replit. It must run instantly and error‑free. No simplified, mock, placeholder, dummy, TODO, simulated, or fake content. Provide all files in full, unshortened, production‑ready code. Do not include an OpenAI key; it is not necessary, so do NOT put it in.
